articles.summary: Net cash used in operating and investing activities was $12.0 million in the third quarter and net cash used in operating and investing activities was $8.9 million for the first nine months of 2026; quarter-end cash and restricted cash position was $272.2 million Novo recently presented post hoc analyses at the Heart Failure Society of America (HFSA) Annual Scientific Meeting from the coramitug Phase 2 trial which demonstrated a decrease of the inflammatory biomarker high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hsCRP) in patients treated with coramitug as compared to an increase in patients on placebo, further supporting the potential of coramitug as a treatment for ATTR-CM Multiple research collaborations with industry partners ongoing to explore the potential of our CYTOPE ® technology over the next 12 to 24 months Prothena Corporation plc (NASDAQ:PRTA), a late-stage clinical biotechnology company with a robust pipeline of investigational therapeutics built on protein dysregulation
